claim.value: A missing entry does not prove that the corresponding event did not occur.
claim.scope: An inference limit on absent records; it does not establish that the event did occur.

provenance.rationale: P030 directly states the identified inference limit.

signal_basis.value: Missing entries and gaps in coverage are preserved explicitly alongside supported sequences and contradictions.
signal_basis.scope: The booking-level investigation using calendar, return, cleaning and collection records.

provenance.rationale: P008 and P019 specify the treatment of missing evidence; P006 identifies the records and investigation scope.
The supported inference limit requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An absent record is compatible with either an unrecorded event or an event that never occurred. The operation supplies no guarantee of complete recording, so missingness alone cannot prove nonoccurrence. This licenses exactly the stated limit.
uncertainty: Whether the corresponding event actually occurred remains unresolved by the missing entry alone.
